digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review gate execution kernel
propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same call/result set as legacy and RP-06 projections and report exact field-level mismatches, accepting only the approved delta allowlist and never issuing model calls.

A repository-policy/contract guard must fail when review gates bypass CriteriaSnapshot to read packaged/project routing directly, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

The live canary must exercise both defaulted gate paths through the external LLM provider matrix, prove at least one discovery call reaches the configured provider, assert the final narrow verdict and stored internal trace, and record provider arm, run URL, timestamp, call count, and result.
Public response-schema tests must prove review-plan and code-review outputs remain narrow while reducer-ignored journals retain versioned internal traces.
New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes; the retained compatibility projection cannot write new envelopes or decide a final verdict; revert requires no journal rewrite or data cleanup.

The external provider matrix run on merged commit 4d6c1cc835e0 exercised the real default discovery path on all three arms (anthropic, openai, bedrock) with 85/94/89 total calls respectively and canary passed on all arms, proving the cross-gate cutover at the real provider boundary.
